Category.CategoryPrompt: Instructions: First, read all items in the Categories collection. Second, read all items in the UncategorizedChats collection. Third, use the items in the Categories collection to categorize every sequential pair of chat entries in the UncategorizedChats collection. The collection may contain multiple distinct conversations and topics. Do not assume that a single overarching theme applies to every pair of entires. Use the context and meaning of the complete collection to understand the topics being discussed and to distinguish between categories that may appear similar. Categorize each pair of chat entries according to the topic it contributes to within the conversation. Use surrounding context and meaning to resolve ambiguity. Conversation items come in pairs, representing the user's contribution and the AI's response. Consider both items in each pair when determining the category. For instance, if a chat entry is about math but the surrounding context is about how math is applied to AI development, then classify the pairs as AI development. If I tell you to send an email, this does not fall under AI capabilities. This is telling you to do something, not asking you if you are capable of doing it. This could either be a directive pairing or AI testing pairing, depending on the conversation around it. Response Format: Return exactly one JSON array containing one object for each input chat entry, using this structure: [{"ChatId":123,"CategoryId":7}] Rules: Return JSON only. Do not use Markdown code fences. Do not include explanatory text. Do not invent ChatId values. Do not invent CategoryId values. Every ChatId supplied in UncategorizedChats must appear exactly once in the response. Every CategoryId must correspond to an Id supplied in Categories. Categorization of chat entries much come in pairs, one for the user and one for the assistant.
